artifact: TF-61 xSuccess OpenEvolve feature-representation discovery (Stage A)
discipline: ADR-093 (OpenEvolve provenance + held-out validation); the evolve PROCESS is documented, not required to be bit-reproducible; the OUTPUT decision is committed
run_commit: pending-commit-1 (seed ships -> the committed silly_kicks/xsuccess/_features.py IS the Stage-A output; no code depends on a specific evolve-run SHA)
run_tree_note: the DGX-Spark run used a non-git synced tree (~/silly-kicks-tf61) with --allow-dirty; the evolve output is a DECISION (seed vs evolved), reviewed by hand, not a bundled weight artifact

corpus.role: DISCOVERY subsample only (feature-representation search needs signal, not full-corpus coverage); the FINAL bundled model trains on the full redistributable open-data corpus at Commit-2

fitness.held_out: StratifiedGroupKFold-by-match, n_splits=5 (this IS the held-out CV; no separate in-sample number reported)
fitness.metric: mean held-out log-loss (lower better); brier + n_features reported alongside
fitness.leakage_guard: hard END-BLIND check in-fitness (_assert_end_blind): inject synthetic end_x/end_y -> features must be byte-identical, else reject (the ReceiverModel bar, spec 6.4)
fitness.single_sourced: the evolve fitness reuses the committed driver scripts/evolve_xsuccess_features.py::evaluate_candidate, so it is byte-identical to the offline --candidate scoring path

runs.fitness_model: xgboost (PRIMARY / shipping family): XGBClassifier(n_estimators=200, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.1, tree_method=hist)
runs.verdict: NULL gain (~0.2% relative). A gradient-boosted tree already learns the geometry/interactions from the raw representation, so hand/evolved features are largely redundant -- a low ceiling by construction.

runs.fitness_model: per_type_logistic-proxy (FALLBACK family; commissioned by owner to fully exercise OpenEvolve where representation matters): standardized LogisticRegression(C=1.0)
runs.verdict: REAL gain (~3% relative), closing ~80% of the linear-vs-tree gap (0.2356 -> 0.2286, near XGBoost's 0.2278). Principled, interpretable, END-BLIND geometry (goal-mouth subtended angle, y-symmetry about the pitch centre, log/exp-decay location transforms, smooth sin/cos bearing for a GLM) + systematic per-type/bodypart geometry interactions.

pre_registered_margin.spec_state: spec 6.1 / SPEC-06 cites 'a pre-registered margin' but NO numeric value was ever pinned in the spec or plan (a gap, recorded honestly rather than back-dated).
pre_registered_margin.robustness: the primary (XGBoost) delta is 0.00057 -- NULL under any sane threshold (even a permissive 0.001), so the seed-ships decision does NOT depend on the margin choice.

decision.outcome: SHIP THE SEED for the shared silly_kicks/xsuccess/_features.py (unchanged). Stage A is evaluated against the shipping family (XGBoost primary, spec 5.4); its gain is null.
decision.logistic_finding: The fallback family (per_type_logistic) WOULD benefit from the evolved geometry, but it ships only if the calibrated XGBoost fails the per-type calibration gate (spec 9.1) at Commit-2.
decision.deferral: Owner decision (2026-09-15): DEFER the logistic finding to the Commit-2 family gate. If the fallback is selected there, adopt a family-specific evolved builder for it then (evolved_logistic_winner.py is the candidate). Not folded into the shared builder now (would bloat the XGBoost feature contract 35->152 columns for ~0 XGBoost gain).
decision.both_winners_end_blind: confirmed by hand-review AND by the in-fitness end-invariance guard (both winners passed; a leaking candidate scores -1e9).
